policy: Classify current vulture findings by runtime discovery mechanism or declarative framework surface. New unreachable-code findings are never allowlisted and must be fixed.

rules.rationale: FastAPI route decorators register these callables dynamically; static import scanning cannot see decorator-based dispatch.
Pydantic models and enums expose fields declaratively for validation/serialization rather than direct Python reads.
Dataclass/typed record fields are constructed and serialized by convention or reflection, not always read directly in package-local code.
FastAPI/Starlette app.state attributes are dynamic framework state consumed through the application object.
Hive services are invoked from routes, websocket handlers, chat/tool dispatch, and operational scripts; this category preserves service APIs pending narrower per-service baselines.
CLI subcommands are invoked through argparse dispatch and command wiring rather than direct function imports.
Bootstrap builder/resolver outputs are public plan fields or feature-slice hooks used by generated plans and product scaffolding.
maistro-core exports package APIs consumed by downstream products and sibling repos, so package-local vulture cannot distinguish all public consumers.
Pytest discovers test functions, fixtures, and helper classes by naming and fixture injection.
Ports and protocol members define supported extension contracts even when concrete use is indirect.
Plugin, registry, and lazy-import entrypoints are intentionally discovered by string/name lookup.
Enum members are serialized values and may not appear as direct reads in package-local static analysis.
Experimental and product-adjacent package APIs are retained as planned implementation surfaces pending per-package hardening specs.
Tool, CLI, route, and handler entrypoints are frequently invoked by dispatch tables, CLIs, frameworks, or external clients.
